Install.description: Quick access straight from your home screen — no app store needed.

Install.androidHint: Open the browser menu (⋮) top-right and choose “Install app”.

Features.title: Features
Features.intro: What the app can do — an overview for users and developers.

liveScoring.title: Live scoring & auto-refresh
liveScoring.desc: Scores and ranking points update automatically while matches are in play — no manual reload.

predicting.title: Predictions & scoring
predicting.desc: One prediction per match. Scoring: exact 5, goal difference 3, tendency 2 points — plus a bonus for the champion pick.

rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.desc: Global ranking and one per department, with position, hit statistics and your own row highlighted.

history.title: Profile & prediction history
history.desc: Your profile with statistics and a full prediction history — sortable, filterable and paginated.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.desc: Reminders for matches you haven't predicted yet — by email and/or push in the installed app, with selectable lead times.

pwaOffline.title: Installable PWA
pwaOffline.desc: Installable as an app on Android and iOS, runs standalone, with an offline page.

passwordReset.title: Password reset
passwordReset.desc: Forgot your password? Secure reset via a time-limited email link.

avatars.title: Avatars
avatars.desc: Upload your own profile picture; clean initials as a fallback otherwise.

languages.title: Multilingual
languages.desc: Fully available in German and English, switchable at any time.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.intro: Everything you need to know about the prediction game at a glance.

howToTip.q: How do I submit a prediction?
howToTip.a: Open the dashboard, pick an upcoming match and enter your predicted goals for the home and away team. You submit exactly one prediction per match.

deadline.a: Until kick-off. Before that you can change your prediction as often as you like – once the match starts it is locked.

regularTimeOnly.q: Which part of the match counts for the prediction?
regularTimeOnly.a: Only regular time counts (90 minutes including stoppage time). In the knockout stage, extra time and penalty shoot-outs are not included.

scoring.a: 5 points for the exact score, 3 points for the correct goal difference (not a draw), 2 points for the correct tendency or a correctly predicted draw, otherwise 0 points.

winnerBonus.q: What does the tournament-winner pick give me?
winnerBonus.a: If the team you openly picked actually wins the World Cup, you earn 12 bonus points.

secretWinner.a: A second, hidden winner pick that must differ from your open pick. If that team wins the World Cup, you get 6 bonus points.

howRanking.a: All points from completed matches plus your bonuses are added up. The ranking is sorted by total points.

globalVsDepartment.q: What is the difference between the global and the department ranking?
globalVsDepartment.a: There is a global ranking across all participants and one ranking per department (Langenfeld, Mannheim, Mainz). Use the tabs to switch between the views.

liveUpdate.a: Live, while matches are in play – scores and points update automatically without you having to reload the page.

whoCanRegister.a: {restricted, select, yes {Anyone with a valid {org} email address.} other {Anyone with a valid email address.}}

passwordReset.q: I forgot my password – what now?
passwordReset.a: On the login page, click “Forgot password?” and enter your email address. You will receive a link to set a new password.

reminders.q: Will I be reminded about matches?
reminders.a: Only if you enable it. In the settings, turn on at least one channel – push (in the browser or the installed app) and/or email. Then choose how long before kick-off you want to be reminded. Without an active channel, no reminders are sent.

installApp.a: Yes. The app is a Progressive Web App and can be added to your home screen from the browser – including offline support and push notifications.

languages.q: Which languages does the app support?
languages.a: German and English. On desktop you switch the language at the top of the header; on mobile and in the installed app you change it in the settings.
